chapters.title: Setting Up Preview Keys and Installation URL
Publishing Options and Breaking Changes Policy

features.name: Preview Key for AppSource Apps
features.description: Publishers can specify a hide key (preview key) in Partner Center that customers can use to access preview listings and versions of their AppSource extensions before public release.
caveats: Preview versions must be the highest version of the extension
If a public version is higher, the public version will be installed instead

features.name: Preview Version Installation URL
features.description: Publishers generate a URL containing the tenant ID, app ID, and preview key that customers can use to install preview versions of extensions on their environments.

features.name: Automatic Preview Key Generation
features.description: If publishers do not specify a preview key during marketplace submission, an automatically generated preview key is created for them, which means they opt into the preview feature automatically.

features.name: Simultaneous Preview Versions
features.description: Publishers can run simultaneous preview versions for different offers with different preview keys, even if those offers have the same apps, allowing for custom behavior testing.

features.name: Breaking Changes in Preview Versions
features.description: Publishers are allowed to perform breaking changes between preview versions of their extensions without affecting the latest public version, providing flexibility during testing.
caveats: Breaking changes must not be introduced to the latest public version

features.name: Sandbox-Only Preview Installation
features.description: Preview versions can only be installed on sandbox environments, not on production environments. Sandbox environments with preview versions cannot be copied or restored to production.
caveats: Sandbox environments with preview versions cannot be copied or restored to production

features.name: Preview to Public Version Updates
features.description: Preview versions can be updated to higher preview versions using an install link with a preview key, or to public versions either via the link without the preview key or directly from admin center.

features.name: Automatic Public Version Promotion
features.description: Installed preview versions are automatically updated to higher public versions based on the app update guidance setting when the environment is updated.

features.name: Preview Version Telemetry Logging
features.description: Operations on extensions are now logged to telemetry, tracking whether installed apps are in preview versions or publicly available, allowing administrators to trace the type of apps in their environment.
